text:
leo: Noticing a small but consistent uptick in schema rejects for tool-invoke on marlin-x-small-q8 after yesterday's quant canary. ~0.4% tool 400s across batches. dash: https://dash.internal/runs/4992
sana: any sample traces? is it truncation or extra garbage?
tom: i pulled some failed payloads. pattern: a stray `\u0002` control char appears right after the JSON array close. parser throws. example: `...\"results\": [ {...} ]\u0002`
vera: that control char looks like a telemetry marker from the new perf-trace codepath. we added a lightweight marker for latency tagging during quant runs. seems it's leaking into streaming chunks when a chunk boundary splits the marker.
leo: repro steps: run a canary with stream=true and kv-cache enabled, long context (~800 tokens). ml-ci-bot attached a small reproducer:
ml-ci-bot: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.internal/invoke \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CANARY' \
  -d '{"model":"marlin-x-small-q8","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"repeat: x200"}],"tools":[{"id":"write_item","schema":{}}]}'
```
sana: two concerns: (1) broken JSON -> 400s; (2) we currently retry on parse failures which causes duplicate tool invocations (observed ~0.02% duplicate writes). ops-bot flagged two Dedicated tenants who saw duplicate rows.
ops-bot: tenants: acme-inc, nodal-analytics. Both reported transient 400 then eventual 200, but their downstream ingestors logged duplicates.
tom: quick mitigation I tried: client-side sanitizer that strips non-printable control chars before parse. small snippet:
```
clean = ''.join(ch for ch in raw if ord(ch) >= 32)
```
works in the canary run but feels brittle.
vera: longer-term fixes: (A) Kernel: stop emitting perf markers in production builds (B) Runtime: add pre-parse sanitizer that strips known markers + non-printables behind a feature flag (C) API: make tool-invoke idempotent by requiring client-provided idempotency_key for side-effecting tools.
leo: (C) is heavier but safest. we should avoid retries on 4xx that are schema/parsing errors. change retry policy to only retry 5xx/timeout.
sana: also let's add a streaming unit test that simulates chunk-split markers. variant: split the perf marker bytes across two chunks and ensure sanitizer normalizes output. I'll draft tests under eng-ml/streaming-sanity.
om: typo^ tom: will do, adding tests and gating by model name in canary.
ml-ci-bot: created job: https://ci.internal/job/4992/stream-marker-split-check
vera: for the idempotency change, product and docs needs to decide how keys are generated; recommend UUID v4 at client SDK layer. also need to update Dedicated contract notes.
leo: immediate plan: 1) runtime sanitize middleware behind ff (vera) 2) kernel prod build toggle to disable markers (vera) 3) change retry policy to skip retries on 4xx parse errors (sana) 4) draft idempotency-key proposal for tool API (leo + product)
sana: i'll open the retry-policy PR and include unit test matrix. link when ready.
vera: kernel PR coming this afternoon: https://git.internal/infra/kernels/pull/218
tom: tests PR: https://git.internal/eng-ml/stream-tests/pull/89
leo: thanks. keep this thread for coordination. ping me for access to the canary traces and dup write logs.
